text: Welcome to the Advanced Azure Database Engineer capstone. This project is built around Overlook Medical Group, a regional healthcare provider network running patient records, appointment scheduling, and billing on Azure SQL.

You've met Overlook twice before in this path. The Beginner capstone built real backup and restore discipline for their database. The Intermediate capstone diagnosed and fixed real performance problems. Both were one person solving one known issue. This project is different, and it's different for a business reason, not a technical one.

A competitor healthcare network suffered a public data breach — it was in the news. Overlook's leadership asked their own board a hard question: could that happen here, and would the company survive it? The honest answer was nobody actually knew. So the board mandated four specific, testable deliverables: a real, tested disaster recovery plan; a real security and compliance posture for patient data; real automation that doesn't depend on one person remembering to run a script; and infrastructure defined as code instead of clicked together by hand.

Next lesson, you'll plan the full architecture — how Bicep-provisioned infrastructure, security and compliance controls, HA/DR, PowerShell automation, and a Data Factory ETL feed all tie together into one production-grade platform — before you build a single piece of it.
